request: In the watchlist, show movies I haven't watched yet before the ones I've watched.

requests.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when the checkbox is clicked
requests.reason: The required new behaviour (unwatched movies listed before watched ones) makes the clicked row move: marking Movie 1 watched drops its row below Movie 2, so the first row becomes Movie 2. This test looked the checkbox up positionally (first row) AFTER the click, so it would assert on Movie 2's unchecked checkbox and fail. I captured the checkbox element before the click so the assertion still targets the movie that was toggled; the behaviour under test (clicking a checkbox toggles that movie's watched state) and all other assertions are unchanged.

requests.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when blank space on the row is clicked
requests.reason: Same conflict with the new ordering: clicking blank space on the first row marks Movie 1 watched, which moves that row to the bottom of the list, so the original post-click positional checkbox() lookup resolves to Movie 2's unchecked checkbox. I capture the checkbox before the click so the assertion still checks the movie whose row was clicked; the behaviour under test (clicking blank row space toggles that movie) is unchanged.

approvals.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when the checkbox is clicked
